scientific_integrity: All optimum-count and parity claims follow from an explicit equality-case bijection and matrix identities. Exhaustive checks through cycle order six serve as finite corroboration, not proof of the infinite family. Source dates distinguish original online publication from later paper revisions.
scientific_limitations: Exact enumeration concerns named-color minimum functions on the labeled sunlet family of order 2n, n>=3. The scalar optimum was established previously. No unlabeled-orbit census or arbitrary-corona extension is claimed. Published priority has been examined for highly relevant primary papers but cannot be guaranteed exhaustively. No independent mathematical validation has been performed.
title: Exact minimum outer-independent two-rainbow function counts on sunlet graphs
